summary: 32 units reviewed; 24 issues (12 error, 12 minor), all with machine patches; no regrouping suggested. Splits, roots, case labels and compound types checked against the Sanskrit and found correct throughout; both text flags (12.01.22 dūṭaṃ -> dūtaṃ; 12.01.32a prayacced -> prayacched) confirmed as real typos with the right suggestion. Author's doubts: 12.01.7 kula-eḍaka split is right (kula + eḍaka, ai sandhi; visarga dropped before iva) and the household-ram reading stands; 12.01.12 reading and medium confidence are fair; 12.01.18 asya = attacker, verb supplied, daṇḍa = force (upāya) is right; 12.01.19 rasa = poison is right; 12.01.24 the sense is right but abhiprayāntam is the second accusative of yāceta (the person asked), not a conditional, so English and Hindi reworded, confidence stays medium. The errors are all bracketed glosses or small additions (ही, भी, किन्तु, स्वयं, 'claimant') inside the Hindi/English, which the glossary forbids. Hindi 'iti X' lines aligned to the convention of other chunks ('ऐसा X कहते हैं'). Glossary extended with the three conquerors, the four upāyas, the four kinds of sandhi, and the agent/troop terms of this chapter. Nothing needs a person.
